result.rationale: The server-side filter at addGuests.handler.ts (`!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email) && !blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`) only compares each guest against the existing attendee snapshot, not against other guests in the same input. The ZAddGuestsInputSchema (z.array(z.string().email())) enforces no uniqueness, so duplicate entries (or case-variant duplicates, since comparison is case-sensitive) pass the filter and are createMany'd as multiple attendee rows, sending duplicate invitations. The client-side dialog does enforce uniqueness via the Set-based refine
